verdict.rationale: The only voicemail evidence is a plans-page mention of managing voicemails on any device and 'visual voicemail' (ringcentral-docs-25). That is an adjacent feature: nothing in the pack documents voicemail transcription or delivery to email or chat. The voicemail-to-email mention in the community thread refers to a competitor (Voipfone), not RingCentral, so it earns no credit.
